name: NuWrrrld Financial
subtitle: Signals · AI · Portfolio Intel
shortDescription: AI signals, portfolio health scoring, and finance AI in one app.
fullDescription:
NuWrrrld Financial gives you an edge with institutional-grade tools made accessible:

📈 SIGNAL DIGEST
Daily and weekly signals from our AI optimizer — each one explained in plain language so you understand the why, not just the what.

🤖 NU AI ASSISTANT
Ask anything about your portfolio, market conditions, or financial concepts. Nu AI answers in the context of your actual holdings.

💼 PORTFOLIO INTELLIGENCE
A health score that grades your portfolio across risk, diversification, and momentum — with concrete suggestions for improvement.

🔔 WATCHLIST ALERTS
Track any ticker and get notified when our signals fire or price thresholds are hit.

⚡ BUILT FOR SCHWAB
Connect your Schwab brokerage account in minutes for fully personalised insights.

────────────────────
NOT FINANCIAL ADVICE
NuWrrrld Financial provides informational tools and analysis. Nothing in the app constitutes personalised investment, financial, legal, or tax advice. Always perform your own due diligence.
────────────────────

7-DAY FREE TRIAL
Try all Pro features free for 7 days. Cancel anytime.
